summary.text: Iris Halpern is the Democratic candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces Republican Kathleen Angel.
According to her campaign website, she is an attorney and partner at the law firm Rathod Mohamedbhai LLC.

paragraphs.text: Iris Halpern advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary.

Her campaign website says that before attending the University of California Berkeley School of Law she worked for many years as a national organizer for the Service Employees International Union, and that she previously served as Acting Supervisory Attorney at the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission in Denver.
The site says her law practice has included employment discrimination, harassment and civil rights cases, and it lists several Colorado bills she says she worked on, including SB23-172 and SB24-216.
She states on the site that she is running to bring her work on civil and constitutional rights and workers' rights to the Capitol.
